query:
SELECT
            (date_trunc('month', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::date AS "month!",
            COUNT(*)                              AS "total!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'up') AS "up!"
        FROM heartbeats
        -- Maintenance excluded from uptime% (matches current_slo_uptime_pct).
        WHERE monitor_id = $1 AND ts >= $2 AND status <> 'maintenance'
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1
